assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent pixel-art game sprite, Juzi catgirl WITHOUT her swim ring, for a knockout flight animation in an existing game. Keep the tiny orange tabby kitten securely perched on her head as part of ONE connected character silhouette, matching the reference kitten's surprised expression. Keep the same huge-head, extremely short chibi proportions and stepped dark-brown pixel outlines. Her face, hair and head-top kitten should closely match the middle reference sprite. Main face: eyes squeezed into cute >< shapes, small surprised open mouth. Scene/backdrop: genuine fully transparent alpha, no environment. Primary edit: remove the ENTIRE orange/cream swim ring and reconstruct the short body previously occluded by it. Show ONE COMPLETE FULL-BODY catgirl from kitten above her head to tiny feet, including her orange striped tail attached behind her lower back. Pose is an airborne tumble key pose, facing the viewer with a slight elevated game-camera view: two short arms held out/up in surprise, tiny legs lightly tucked and bent, compact silhouette. Modest opaque cream/orange sailor romper with short puffed shorts and little cream socks/orange shoes, coherent with the existing costume; no exposed belly, no underwear. Do not lengthen her body: head/hair/ears take about 65 percent of total main-character height, body plus feet about 35 percent. Composition: single upright isolated sprite centered in a portrait canvas with generous transparent margins, all ears, paws, tail and feet fully visible, no clipping, no duplicates, no ground shadow. No ring, no floating ring fragments, no water, no waterline, no effects, no UI, no text, no color swatches, no checkerboard painted into the image. This asset must be usable independently of a separate ring sprite. Match the attached game's established art rather than redesigning her.

Nothing else: NO catgirl, NO kitten, NO cat ears, NO paws, NO hands, NO human, NO tail, NO water, NO shadow, NO ripples, NO effect particles, NO text, NO reference-sheet layout, NO checkerboard painted on the background.
